reviewer_scope: Implementation-independent semantic clarification candidates and bounded HSBM literature/reuse assessment. Source inspection and planning only; no authority adjudication, proof, checker, build, mutation or scientific-artifact generation.
constitutional_basis: Shared tests, clearer specifications and documented unresolved disagreements are preferred ecosystem outputs.
Methods are replaceable; closing a survivor classification has no intrinsic priority over an externally useful regression or clarification.
Historical source and checker behavior discover questions but cannot establish semantic authority.
External authorization gates submission rather than preparation of a concrete contribution.

state_review.judgment: The one-thread operational survivor has a precise bounded question, but its present useful external output is less direct than an existing regression contribution, shared-corpus isolation improvement, or a source-supported semantic clarification. Preserve it as a fallback instead of allowing the remaining-survivor count to determine project priority.
semantic_state: The publication-study authority adjudication established DECL.THEOREM.TYPE_PROP while preserving fourteen other preregistered candidates as PROVISIONAL.

CVC-U1-A7 provides a checked conditional universe contract under seven explicit assumptions and finite observer evidence; its package supplies no arbitrary-byte importer refinement or universal universe-ownership obligation.

The proof-parameter case compares structural parameter identity with definitional equality but edited expression nodes are shared into recursor annotations; it is not isolated solely to the constructor result.
Restored nested recursor k/type and constructor-index observations describe a tested disagreement family. The matrix itself does not settle the import/reconstruction contract.

hsbm_review.operational_position: A candidate-discovery and prioritization method feeding the corpus, checker-regression and semantic-clarification lanes. Its first assessment should measure actionable candidate yield and review cost, not claim superiority to broad mutation testing without a comparator.
required_refinements: Represent reachability relative to an interface and input class. The stated zero-thread example establishes a missing-field default remapping. A global newly reachable state claim would also require excluding explicit zero in the parent; that exclusion has not been established by this review.

Record separate historical boundary kinds: expansion, default remapping, state refinement, stronger enforcement, interacting configuration and executable test wiring. Cache-key refinement and new rejection checks need not expand externally reachable states.
Treat commit subjects as ranking signals. Bind exact changed hunks and their dependency context because a commit can mix several tasks.

Keep known motivating commits as calibration anchors outside any fresh-yield denominator. Fix an interval, selection rules, matched low-score controls, nearby-test window and analyst-time budget before inspecting new candidates.
Record state reached, property asserted, suite integration and timing separately. Test-file churn alone does not establish coverage or its absence.

A preserved correct implementation can still justify a preventive regression. Require a stable invariant, demonstrated test weakness and maintainable test; do not require a current defect as the only positive contribution path.
Use independent oracle/contract reasoning when converting behavioral differences into expected outcomes. A history-derived behavioral difference alone cannot determine which side should be accepted.
hsbm_review.minimal_missing_implementation: A deterministic revision/hunk inventory, content bindings, transparent scoring, candidate record and test-wiring audit. Reuse git and the Lab evidence machinery; defer symbolic engines, general AST analysis and automated mutation generation until concrete candidates require them.

literature_review.decision_question: Which established change-directed test generation, boundary adequacy and history-mining practices should a bounded HSBM prototype reuse?
literature_review.scope: Six search queries; four selected primary-source groups plus one author landing page used to obtain a paper. Relevant sections inspected; no exhaustive literature review, software installation or tool trial.

sources.title: Generating Test Suites with Augmented Dynamic Symbolic Execution
sources.authors: Konrad Jamrozik, Gordon Fraser, Nikolai Tillmann, Jonathan de Halleux
sources.version: TAP 2013 author paper hosted by Microsoft Research
sources.consulted_sections: Abstract and sections 1-2, especially same-path values and boundary/mutation adequacy.
sources.relevance: Branch or path coverage can miss important boundary values; added conditions can target boundary and mutation criteria.
sources.reuse_decision: Reuse the distinction between structural coverage and boundary adequacy. Do not import the .NET/Pex implementation for the first Nanoda source-review pilot.

sources.title: Unit Test Generation During Software Development: EvoSuite Plugins for Maven, IntelliJ and Jenkins
sources.authors: Andrea Arcuri, Jose Campos, Gordon Fraser
sources.version: ICST 2016 author paper hosted by the EvoSuite project
sources.consulted_sections: Introduction and section IV on continuous test generation, history-based budget allocation and existing-test reuse.
sources.relevance: History can prioritize generation effort toward changed classes and reuse previous tests; the paper explicitly distinguishes file changes from more precise syntactic changes.
sources.reuse_decision: Reuse budget-aware changed-code prioritization and retained regression reuse. HSBM needs an obligation/state layer beyond file hashes; Java/Maven integration is outside the pilot.

sources.title: Identifying Test-Suite-Overfitted Patches through Test Case Generation
sources.version: ISSTA 2017 author manuscript; hosted PDF contains draft DOI metadata, so title/authors/venue/year are the citation identity
sources.consulted_sections: Abstract, introduction, sections 2 and 3.1 on differences, generated inputs and external oracle judgment.
sources.relevance: Change-focused generation distinguishes old and patched behavior; an oracle is still needed to judge the difference and produce assertions.
sources.reuse_decision: Reuse separation of reaching a change, observing a difference and assigning expected behavior. The Java repair setting and fixed-version oracle do not establish Lean semantic obligations.

sources.title: Untangling Changes
sources.version: Author research project, release 0.1 dated 2011-09-29, dataset correction described 2012-11-19; page last marked 2018-04-05
sources.consulted_sections: Why untangling changes, atomic fixes and obvious blobs.
sources.relevance: Commits may combine multiple developer tasks. Commit-message labels can introduce noise and bias into history-based inference.
sources.reuse_decision: Require hunk-level attribution and preserve uncertain atomicity; do not infer a semantic boundary solely from the word safety, fix or refactor.

exclusions_and_limits: Differential Symbolic Execution (Person et al., FSE 2008) appeared through a mirror and indexes; not selected as a relied-on source because the bounded review obtained more direct author-hosted material for the operational decisions.
REST API differential regression testing is relevant adjacent work, but its protocol/specification setting was not needed for the four selected reuse decisions.
Search engine date labels were not treated as publication dates; author/venue/page information identifies the cited versions.
No conclusion about absence of closer published work or global novelty follows.
The reviewed sources are planning references, not frozen scientific or normative source bindings. An executed method study must bind its own exact relied-on source snapshots.
literature_review.terminal_recommendation: EXTEND: reuse change-directed selection, boundary adequacy, retained tests, separate oracles and hunk-level attribution; build only the small history-to-obligation recording layer.
